detail.text:
`bash check` passes (vet, gofmt, gosec, race tests, web lint/build).

Changes: `internal/server/routes_auth.go` — POST /api/signup (email + ≥10-char password validation, bcrypt, user create, session cookie, user JSON), POST /api/login, POST /api/logout (deletes the DB session, expires the cookie), GET /api/me, plus an in-memory mutex-guarded attempt map limiting 10 signup/login attempts per minute per client IP (429 beyond). Sessions reuse the store's existing `sessions` table, so no new migration was needed; `go.mod` gains golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt. Tests in `routes_auth_test.go`: TestSignup, TestLogin, TestLogout, TestRateLimitAuth (11th attempt → 429, other IPs unaffected) plus invalid-input and helper tests. Recommend merging: all acceptance items are covered and checks are green.
